evidence.result: Mollia lepidota certainly has two stamen lengths within the same flower
M. lepidota is among Mollia species with five longer outer stamen cohorts bearing green pollen and five shorter inner cohorts bearing yellow pollen

evidence.source: Maguire 1978, The botany of the Guayana Highland part X
evidence.result: five outer stamen phalanges about 2 cm long and five inner phalanges about 1.5 cm long
Mollia lepidota is accepted in Malvaceae

interpretation: This is a species-level independent family representative. It does not assert that the inaccessible 2010 Table S1 Malvaceae row was Mollia lepidota.
